cues.en: DSSTNE is open source and you'll find it on GitHub.
cues.zh: DSSTNE 是開放原始碼的，可以在 GitHub 找到。

cues.en: It's made for Ubuntu systems that have one or more GPUs attached.
cues.zh: 它是為搭載一個或多個 GPU 的 Ubuntu 系統設計的。

cues.en: A GPU is the core of a 3D video card, which can also be used to run neural networks on.
cues.zh: GPU 是 3D 顯示卡的核心，也能用來執行神經網路。

cues.en: I don't have a system like that handy, so I'm going to use Amazon's EC2 service to rent time on one instead.
cues.zh: 我手邊沒有這樣的系統，所以要改用 Amazon EC2 服務租用一台。

cues.en: The kind of machine you need for this isn't cheap, so I'm not going to ask you to follow along here as it would cost you real money.
cues.zh: 這種機器並不便宜，所以我不會要求你跟著操作，因為這會真的花錢。

cues.en: What we're doing does not fall under Amazon's free usage tier for people who are just starting and experimenting.
cues.zh: 我們要做的事不在 Amazon 提供給初學與實驗用途的免費用量方案範圍內。

cues.en: If you want to see all of the steps involved in getting the machine itself set up with all the necessary hardware, it's all detailed on the setup page for the project in GitHub here.
cues.zh: 如果想看如何準備機器，配置所有必要硬體，GitHub 專案的設定頁面都有詳細說明。

cues.en: But I'm going to skip past the steps for actually procuring a machine and installing this necessary software, and just jump straight to playing around with this example.
cues.zh: 不過，我要跳過取得機器與安裝必要軟體的步驟，直接試用這個範例。

cues.en: Instructions for running the example are also here in GitHub.
cues.zh: GitHub 這裡也有執行範例的說明。

cues.en: They point out that generally, using DSSTNE involves three steps, converting your data, training, and prediction.
cues.zh: 說明指出，一般使用 DSSTNE 有三個步驟：轉換資料、訓練、預測。

cues.en: First, let's go to the directory that contains the movielens example.
cues.zh: 首先，進入包含 movielens 範例的目錄。

cues.en: We'll start by downloading the movielens' 20 million rating dataset from grouplens.
cues.zh: 先從 GroupLens 下載 MovieLens 的兩千萬筆評分資料集。

cues.en: All we actually need is the ratings data, so we will extract that from the zip archive and save it as ml-20m_ratings.csv.
cues.zh: 實際上只需要評分資料，所以從 ZIP 壓縮檔解出它，存成 ml-20m_ratings.csv。

cues.en: DSSTNE, however, can't deal with CSV files, nor does it want data that's organized as one rating per line.
cues.zh: 但是 DSSTNE 無法處理 CSV 檔案，也不接受每一行一筆評分的資料排列方式。

cues.en: Ultimately, DSSTNE requires file formats in NetCDF format.
cues.zh: 最終，DSSTNE 要求資料採用 NetCDF 格式。

cues.en: They provide a tool that can convert files into it, but that conversion tool also has its own requirements.
cues.zh: 他們提供了轉換成這個格式的工具，但轉換工具本身也有要求。

cues.en: So we need to convert our ratings data into a format that can then be converted into NetCDF.
cues.zh: 所以必須先把評分資料轉成另一種格式，才能再轉成 NetCDF。

cues.en: This first step requires arranging our data so that every row represents a single user, followed by a list of all of the rating inputs for that user.
cues.zh: 第一步是重新排列資料，讓每一列代表一位使用者，後面接著該使用者所有評分輸入的清單。

cues.en: What we want is each line to contain a user ID, followed by a tab, followed by a colon-separated list of each item ID that user rated.
cues.zh: 我們要讓每一行包含使用者 ID，接一個 Tab，再接上以冒號分隔的項目 ID 清單，列出該使用者評過的每個項目。

cues.en: If you think about it, that's basically a Sparse Representation of the input layer for each individual user, one user per line.
cues.zh: 想一下，這基本上就是每位使用者輸入層的稀疏表示，每行一位使用者。

cues.en: So this input format gets us very close to what we need to train our neural network with.
cues.zh: 所以這個輸入格式已經非常接近訓練神經網路所需的格式。

cues.en: Amazon provides an AWK script to convert our CSV file into the intermediate format.
cues.zh: Amazon 提供一個 AWK 指令稿，把 CSV 檔案轉成這個中間格式。

cues.en: Let's take a quick look with the cat convert_ratings.awk.
cues.zh: 用 cat convert_ratings.awk 快速看一下。

cues.en: It takes advantage that all of the ratings data for a given user are grouped together in the raw movielens data.
cues.zh: 它利用了原始 MovieLens 資料中，同一位使用者的評分都排在一起這個特性。

cues.en: It just collects all the ratings for each user, then spits out a line for each user when it's done.
cues.zh: 它只要收集每位使用者的所有評分，收集完後就為該使用者輸出一行。

cues.en: Let's go ahead and run that conversion script.
cues.zh: 執行這個轉換指令稿吧。

cues.en: And if we take a peek at the output,
cues.zh: 如果看一下輸出，

cues.en: we can see that it does contain training data, one user per line, with the items that user rated in a Sparse format.
cues.zh: 可以看到裡面確實有訓練資料，每行一位使用者，以稀疏格式列出他評過的項目。

cues.en: Now, we need to convert this into the NetCDF format DSSTNE requires.
cues.zh: 現在要把它轉成 DSSTNE 要求的 NetCDF 格式。

cues.en: This actually generates three files, the NetCDF file itself, an index file with the indices of each neuron, and an index file with the indices of all samples.
cues.zh: 這其實會產生三個檔案：NetCDF 檔本身、包含每個神經元索引的索引檔，以及包含所有樣本索引的索引檔。

cues.en: We also need to generate the output layer's data file using the same sample indices that we generated for the input file.
cues.zh: 也要產生輸出層的資料檔案，並沿用為輸入檔產生的樣本索引。

cues.en: Now, we're ready to rock.
cues.zh: 現在準備好了。

cues.en: Let's take a quick peak at config.json again, which defines the topology of our neural network and how it is trained.
cues.zh: 再快速看一下 config.json，它定義神經網路的拓樸與訓練方式。

cues.en: It's the same file we looked at in the slides and already covered, but again, there at the end is the meat of the three layers in our neural network.
cues.zh: 這與投影片上已經介紹過的是同一個檔案。再提醒一下，最後面就是神經網路三個層的核心定義。

cues.en: It's pretty amazing how simple this looks.
cues.zh: 看起來這麼簡單，真的很驚人。

cues.en: But remember, there's a lot of complexity that's being hidden from you here involving Sparse autoencoders, a tuned loss function, and a denoising feature as well as all the complexity
cues.zh: 但記得，背後隱藏了很多複雜性，包括稀疏自編碼器、調整過的損失函數、去雜訊功能，以及處理稀疏資料，

cues.en: that comes with the Sparse data and distributing the training of this data across a neural network that's not running on our CPU, but on the GPU and possibly even multiple GPUs.
cues.zh: 還有將資料訓練分散到神經網路所涉及的各種複雜性；它不是在 CPU 上，而是在 GPU，甚至可能是多個 GPU 上執行。

cues.en: It's pretty amazing what's going on here.
cues.zh: 這背後的運作真的很驚人。

cues.en: Let's kick it off with parameters that indicate a batch size of 256 and 10 epochs.
cues.zh: 開始執行，參數指定批次大小為 256，訓練 10 個 epoch。

cues.en: That was actually amazingly quick for 20 million ratings.
cues.zh: 以兩千萬筆評分來說，這個速度快得驚人。

cues.en: If you had more than one GPU, it would be even faster.
cues.zh: 如果有不只一個 GPU，還會更快。

cues.en: In that case, there's an mpirun command you would use instead of the train command.
cues.zh: 那種情況下，會使用 mpirun 命令取代 train 命令。

cues.en: The output of this is the gl.nc file, which contains the trained model itself.
cues.zh: 輸出是 gl.nc 檔案，裡面包含訓練好的模型本身。

cues.en: So now that we have our trained model, let's use it to create top 10 recommendations for every user.
cues.zh: 既然模型訓練好了，就用它為每位使用者建立前十名推薦。

cues.en: Oops, got a typo there, forgot a dash.
cues.zh: 糟糕，有個打字錯誤，少了一個連字號。

cues.en: The parameters there are all pretty self-explanatory.
cues.zh: 那些參數的意義都很容易理解。

cues.en: k 10 means we want top 10 recommendations and we are passing in our model that lives in the gl.nc file.
cues.zh: k 10 代表要取前十名推薦，另外傳入儲存在 gl.nc 檔案中的模型。

cues.en: One thing worth mentioning, however, is that the predict command will automatically do filtering as well, which is why we're passing in the ml-20m ratings file again.
cues.zh: 不過，值得一提的是，predict 命令也會自動進行篩選，所以我們才會再次傳入 ml-20m 評分檔案。

cues.en: This allows it to filter out items the user has already rated.
cues.zh: 這讓它可以濾除使用者已經評過的項目。

cues.en: That didn't take very long.
cues.zh: 沒花多久就完成了。

cues.en: So the results are in the recs file.
cues.zh: 結果在 recs 檔案中。

cues.en: Let's take a peek at it.
cues.zh: 看一下。

cues.en: Each line is a user ID, followed by a list of their recommended items and scores.
cues.zh: 每一行是使用者 ID，後面接推薦項目及其分數的清單。

cues.en: Unfortunately, it's not human-readable, but let's spot-check a few.
cues.zh: 可惜不容易直接閱讀，但我們抽查幾筆。

cues.en: I've opened up the movies.csv file in Excel, so we can look up a few of these recommended item IDs and see what movies they correspond to.
cues.zh: 我已經在 Excel 開啟 movies.csv 檔案，可以查詢其中幾個推薦項目 ID，看看它們對應哪些電影。

cues.en: Let's check out the first few movies for our user one.
cues.zh: 來看使用者 1 的前幾部電影。

cues.en: They turn out to be 1196.
cues.zh: 第一個是 1196。

cues.en: Star Wars, which one?
cues.zh: 是 Star Wars 的哪一部？

cues.en: The Empire Strikes Back.
cues.zh: The Empire Strikes Back。

cues.en: What's the next one?
cues.zh: 下一個呢？

cues.en: Lord of The Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring.
cues.zh: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring。

cues.en: That's pretty exciting.
cues.zh: 這很令人興奮。

cues.en: It seems to have nailed user one as a science fiction and fantasy fan, and recommended some of the greatest science fiction and fantasy movies of all time.
cues.zh: 它似乎準確辨識出使用者 1 是科幻與奇幻迷，推薦了一些史上最棒的科幻與奇幻電影。

cues.en: Let's reflect again on what just happened here.
cues.zh: 再回顧一下剛才發生了什麼。

cues.en: We trained a feedforward three-layer neural network with Sparse data from 20 million ratings in just a few minutes by using the power of a GPU to accelerate that neural network.
cues.zh: 我們利用 GPU 的運算能力加速神經網路，只花幾分鐘，就以兩千萬筆評分的稀疏資料訓練出一個三層前饋式神經網路。

cues.en: There was no need to deal with all the complexity of RBMs in order to apply neural networks to recommender systems.
cues.zh: 要把神經網路應用到推薦系統，不必再處理 RBM 的各種複雜細節。

cues.en: DSSTNE has made it, so we can apply deep learning directly to this problem and think of it as any other classification problem a deep neural network might excel at.
cues.zh: DSSTNE 讓我們能直接把深度學習用在這個問題，把它視為深度神經網路擅長的其他分類問題之一。

cues.en: It's purpose-built for applying deep learning to recommender systems.
cues.zh: 它是專為將深度學習應用於推薦系統而打造。

cues.en: And that in itself is pretty darn exciting.
cues.zh: 光是這一點，就已經很令人興奮。
